itemList.description: Overhauling and complete rewinding of the HV and LV windings of an existing 1000 kVA, 3-Phase, 50 Hz, 11000/3300 Volts, Dyn11 Vector Group, ONAN-cooled, oil-immersed power transformer conforming to IS:2026, matching or improving upon the original Basic Insulation Levels (BIL) of 75 kVp (HV)/40 kVp (LV), the comprehensive scope under this single composite-rate item comprising: (a) safe vertical un-tanking of the core-coil assembly, core inspection, inter-lamination insulation rectification, structural consolidation, and core-bolt re-tightening to eliminate magnetostrictive deformation; (b) stripping of the failed windings and supply and winding of new Electrolytic-Grade Copper conductor using Class-E pre-compressed pressboard formers and Double Paper Covered (DPC) insulation, followed by multi-stage thermal stabilization and hot-air/vacuum chamber drying; (c) complete tank interior flushing and de-sludging, and replacement of all deteriorated Neoprene/Cork gaskets, O-rings, and bushing seals to ensure leak-proof reassembly; and replacement of transformer oil by deducting salvage value of released oil (d) mandatory workshop routine tests including micro-ohm winding resistance, voltage ratio and vector group verification, and HV insulation resistance (megohmmeter) testing; (e) to-and-fro flatbed transport with certified hydraulic mobile crane rigging at both site and factory ends; and (f) final on-site precision alignment, re-erection, pre-commissioning testing, and supervised line-charging under the direction and certification of the Engineer-in-Charge; the rate quoted shall be on a strict net-payable basis after deducting the salvage value of the recovered old copper winding scrap, which shall become the property of the contractor upon final line-charging approval
